menu.starfall.details.railgun: A red laser from space marks your crosshair. Out past the galaxy's rim the railgun charges and fires: a beam 200 blocks in radius cuts the whole column away, from the build limit to the void. Everything inside dies, totems and second phases included. In creative you are lifted into the sky first.
menu.starfall.details.gungnir: A kilometre-long needle is spun up seven laps around Jupiter and flung at the Earth. It strikes in silence: a shock ring planes 400 blocks flat into a molten crater, then the boom arrives. The shock still throws and hurts past the rim. The needle stays standing, and nothing breaks it.
menu.starfall.details.seven_stars: The Big Dipper is projected onto the land with Megrez on your crosshair, 1,440 blocks across. Its seven stars fall one by one, each digging a crater as wide as the star is bright and leaving a star-core crystal. Then the lines burn into the land. In creative the ground under your feet is spared.
